title: Hidden Passage
description: The alley narrows into a quiet corridor where two buildings face each other like strangers sharing a secret. Their walls carry layers of time—paint, cracks, graffiti—while trees bloom low and stubborn, softening the hard edges. Overhead, the sky bends and drifts out of alignment, turning the passage into a place that feels slightly off, as if reality took a wrong turn and didn’t correct itself.
